blurb: Guests fish for species like Barracuda, Tarpon, Snapper, Permit, Jack Crevalle, and Grouper using fly fishing, drift fishing, popping, and spinning techniques. Trips range from 4 to 10 hours, departing typically from Historic Charter Boat Row. Eco-tours focus on wildlife and bird watching in local wildlife refuges.
